أَثِيمٌ : see آثِمٌ. ―
-b2- Also A great, or habitual, liar; or one who lies much; and so ↓ أَثُومٌ . (K.) So in the Kur ii. 277: or it there signifies Burdened with إثْم [or sin, &c.]. (TA.) In the Kur xliv. 44, it means, accord. to Fr, The unrighteous, or sinning; like ↓ آثِمٌ : (T:) or the unbeliever: (TA:) or, accord. to Zj, in this instance, (M,) by the اثيم is meant Aboo-Jahl. (M, K.) ＝
-A2- Also The commission of إِثْم [sin, or crime, &c.,] much, or frequently; and so ↓ أَثِيمَةٌ . (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
